/ Weekly Recap: Shipments down 21% and Xiaomi orders Xring chips
Weekly Recap: Shipments down 21% and Xiaomi orders Xring chips
Xiaomi Corporation Class B (HKEX:1810) reported a 21% YoY drop in Q2 smartphone shipments tied to low‑end mix even as it readies advanced O100 and D100 chips from TSMC for next‑year AI and driving applications, repurchased 1.8M shares and launched three Mijia air purifiers in India.
Xiaomi Class B Slips In Shipments : Xiaomi Class B (1810) saw Q2 smartphone shipments fall 21% year‑over‑year—the biggest drop among major Chinese brands—attributed mainly to its heavy reliance on low‑end models.
Xiaomi 1810 Orders TSMC Chips : Xiaomi (1810) ordered two Xring chips from TSMC: the O100 6nm NPU for on-device MiMo LLM and the D100 3nm chip for autonomous driving, both slated for deployment next year.
Xiaomi Class B Repurchases 1.8M Shares : Xiaomi Class B (1810) repurchased 1.8M shares on Aug 24 for HK$50.8M, per HKEX filing — shows shares bought, cash spent and transaction date.
Xiaomi Launches Mijia Purifiers India : Xiaomi Corp Class B (1810) launched three Mijia air purifiers in India: Smart Air Purifier 6 (CADR 443 m³/h, covers ~940 sq ft) , 4 Lite (CADR 360 m³/h) , 4 Compact. Prices: ₹19,999; ₹12,999; ₹7,999.
